Core purpose

For a specific credit application and client account, make an authorization or denial by predetermined standards and complete credit verification, ensuring the data source and applicable standard are clear and the decision is reviewable and explainable and the records are traceable.

Compare by main tasks: credit analysis includes financial statement ratios and risk reports; loan officers also analyze credit and approve within a limit or refer for approval; accounting and auditing prepare and audit financial statements and tax; financial managers coordinate funds and teams and have loan approval; bookkeeping clerks maintain accounts and reconcile differences; tellers handle cash and client accounts and also have loan document tasks.
Main object and basis

The object is credit applications and records and accounts and fee payments; handled by the institution's predetermined standards and actual authority. Chinese PIPL/credit reporting/loan rules and the US Regulation B notice provisions are verified separately, and adverse action notice cannot be called a Chinese rule across the board.

Adjacent positions may share credit and financial and client account and loan material, focusing respectively on risk analysis or the loan process or financial statement auditing or financial coordination or bookkeeping records or counter transactions, and a hard line cannot be drawn simply because the material is the same.
Core process
Receive application → interview and obtain credit reporting → review public records for verification → evaluate by predetermined standards → decide and notify → record fee payments and collection.

Credit analysis does financial statement ratios and risk reports; loan officers analyze credit and approve within a limit or refer; accounting and auditing prepare and audit accounts; financial managers handle funding risk and loan decisions; bookkeeping clerks record and reconcile accounts; tellers verify transactions and handle client documents.
Main outputs

Authorization or denial decisions with reason statements, credit verification and public record verification results, investigation results and recommendation reports, fee and payment records, and collection records.

Outputs of adjacent positions: credit risk reports (credit analysts), loan application materials (loan officers), financial statements and audit opinions (accounting and auditing), financial plans and control results (financial managers), ledgers and reconciliation results (bookkeeping clerks), counter transactions and account records (tellers).
Responsible party

Credit authorizers and checkers and clerks are responsible for data verification and applying the applicable standard and the accuracy of the authorization or denial and the reason statement and record completeness; decisions beyond their authority must be escalated per policy and are not decided unilaterally.

Actual responsibility is verified by duty and authorization; loan officers are not only business promotion, and managers are not only team management; adjacent positions may also handle credit or loans or collection, and authority does not shift automatically because of the occupation name.
Collaboration and supervision

Collect and verify materials from business and clients and credit services and other positions per the real permission; editorial anomaly suggestion: record the facts and gaps and to-be-verified items and contact the authorized position per real authority; ordinary complaints should be verified within authority and not all handling should be stopped, and this page does not grant the right to suspend the whole business or restore it.

Collaboration of adjacent positions: credit analysts collaborate with approval and risk control; loan officers collaborate with clients and approval positions; accounting and auditing collaborate with client management and regulators; financial managers collaborate with executives and departments; bookkeeping clerks collaborate with accounting and business departments; tellers collaborate with branch supervisors and back office.

The main object and outputs together with the specific authorization define the scope, and credit analysis and authorization verification and loan and account and financial management tasks may overlap; they must not be interchanged by name, and it must not be claimed that this position never analyzes credit.

values: Hypothetical credit application scenario material (practice input)

Hypothetical situation: a credit authorization and verification officer receives a hypothetical personal credit application and encounters four problems. First, the monthly income the applicant states does not match the amount on the income certificate provided; second, the applicant urges by phone to approve it first and supply the materials tomorrow; third, the credit reporting query result shows a recent overdue item not mentioned in the application; fourth, a billing cycle is near and the supervisor asks for that day's applications to be finished as soon as possible.

Given materials: the credit application and purpose statement; an income certificate and partial bank statements; credit reporting query records; the institution's predetermined standard and authorization scope description; and a document list and record template.

Materials not given: the rule for judging which side prevails when income figures differ, the authorization basis for whether handling can start before materials are complete, and the discretion rule for how to handle and notify when an undisclosed overdue item is found. If the practice needs these conditions, state clearly your assumptions and the party you need to confirm them with.
Task requirements

Please write a one-page handling and communication plan: including the verification and consultation for the income discrepancy, the acceptance and record when materials are incomplete, the standard application and handling for the undisclosed overdue item, and a statement of the handling before the billing cycle and the to-be-confirmed items.

The plan must state which information comes from the prompt material and which is still an assumption, and explain whether it relies on the institution's predetermined standard or the authorization scope description or the document list template.
Reference deliverables (derivable from the prompt)

The plan should include: income discrepancy (list both figures and explain the reason for and impact of the difference, ask the authorized person to confirm which side prevails, keep the written confirmation before deciding, and do not choose one side on your own), incomplete materials (explain the missing items and their impact on the decision, confirm per policy whether handling can start first and record it, and do not approve or promise a limit in advance based on a verbal promise), undisclosed overdue item (evaluate the impact of that overdue item by the predetermined standard, verify whether it is a matter that should be disclosed, and if it affects the decision handle it truthfully and give specific
reasons without hiding the record), handling before the billing cycle (state honestly the verified and to-be-confirmed and unverifiable parts and do not omit verification and reasons to meet the cycle), and handover (state clearly the status of the four matters and the actions taken and the to-be-confirmed items).
The reference deliverables list only the elements that should be included and do not require wording identical to the example; being able to explain the judgment basis is enough.

description.text:
Credit authorizers and checkers and clerks (O*NET-SOC 
43-4041.00) authorize credit transactions on client accounts and investigate the applicant's history and credit status: covering receiving credit applications, interviewing to collect personal and financial data, obtaining and exchanging credit reporting information, reviewing public records for verification, evaluating credit records and repayment history by predetermined standards, preparing investigation results and recommendation reports, processing applications and notifying acceptance or denial, recording fees and payments, and selecting overdue accounts and collecting by phone; includes the US 2025 median annual wage of 50,080

subject.name: Credit authorizers, checkers, and clerks
subject.summary:
In the United States, credit authorizers and checkers and clerks correspond to O*NET-SOC 43-4041.00 (Credit Authorizers, Checkers, and Clerks). The core is authorizing credit transactions on client accounts and investigating the history and credit status of individual or enterprise applicants: receiving credit applications and sales slips sent by mail or phone, collecting the personal and financial data needed to complete a credit report in person or by phone
, obtaining information from banks and credit reporting agencies and other credit service providers and providing information mutually on request, reviewing public records to verify residence and property and bankruptcy and liens and debts or unpaid tax and other matters, evaluating computerized credit records and repayment history by predetermined standards to decide whether to approve new credit, summarizing and analyzing the credit information investigated and preparing investigation results and recommendation reports, processing applications and notifying acceptance or denial, mailing statements to clients and recording fees and payments, selecting overdue accounts from client files and
collecting by phone, and communicating with clients to resolve complaints or verify financial and credit transactions. The US basis is a single occupation segment, while similar positions on the China side are spread across bank credit front office and consumer finance and credit reporting services, which is not a one-to-one correspondence with that US occupation segment, and the appointment and authorization and pay bases cannot be interchanged.
